Card Q&A.a: A {Trash} effect can be triggered/activated while its card is in the trash. It can't be triggered or activated in areas other than the trash.

Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's {Trash} [Main] effect, then declare an Assembly for this card when it's played to further reduce its play cost?

Card Q&A.a: Each player chooses the cards in their own hand to trash respectively.
Card Q&A.q: When both players trash cards in their hand for this card's [All Turns] effect, which player chooses the cards to trash?

Effect: {Trash} [Main] If your hand has 5 or fewer cards, play this card with the cost reduced by 4.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your opponent's Digimon are played or digivolve, both players trash cards in their hand so that they have 4 left.
